quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on his motivation and physical preparation this season
quotes.excerpt: I'm hungry and I'm not satisfied. I've experienced some incredible moments in my basketball life.
quotes.quote: I'm hungry and I'm not satisfied. I've experienced some incredible moments in my basketball life, but I came here to Miami to experience more and create memories that I'll hold dearly for the rest of my life. I'm fortunate to have the start I've had this season because I put in so much work these past six months to get in the best shape I possibly can. I give so much credit to the training staff and the athletic training department of our organization. These guys and girls got me in such great shape and they hold me accountable every day to be my best self. Spol does the same thing. He brought me in his office telling me Father Time could be knocking on the door if I don't take my craft more serious, and that really jump-started me to do the extra work every day, not just get my shots up, but do all the little things that you don't see on a daily basis.
quotes.social_post: Klay Thompson reveals Erik Spoelstra gave him a reality check about Father Time: He brought me in his office telling me Father Time could be knocking on the door if I do not take my craft more serious. That jump started me to do the extra work.

structured.context: Klay Thompson discusses his physical preparation and credits Erik Spoelstra for motivating him to take his conditioning more seriously.
